audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart handed Kayle levels 3 and 4-5 and called level 2 a skill lane, while every prose line on the page says the opposite ('there is no trade you win here', 'you cannot punish him before 6', 'keep paying rent through levels 4-5'). It also disagreed with the packet chart and with the already-audited Gangplank-side page.
audit.why: Kayle is melee with no waveclear until 6; Powder Keg has no cooldown on placement and Parrrley detonates it from 625 range, so Gangplank owns levels 1-5.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-3 flipped to Gangplank and row 4 to Skill in both layers as one atomic group, ratings adjusted to match, and the four phases[].why lines rewritten so the chart and prose agree. This mirrors the Gangplank-side audit exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase was generic boilerplate and gave no number for Divine Judgment.
audit.why: Level 6 is the exact point the lane evens: Divine Ascent makes autos ranged and R is a 160s rank-1 answer to his all-in burst.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Divine Ascent, Divine Judgment's 160s rank-1 cooldown, and states the lane is even from there.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent from the writable text: Remove Scurvy heals through chip so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades, and Cannon Barrage deals true damage so stacking resistances is the wrong answer.
audit.why: Both are flagged in _missing for this matchup and both are confirmed by the kit flags (W heal, R trueDamage).
audit.corrected: Itemization line now calls for Grievous Wounds against Remove Scurvy; spikes[3].text now states Cannon Barrage is true damage and ignores armour and MR.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Use Remove Scurvy' in wants.foe[1]; Remove Scurvy is Gangplank's real W name, so this is a false positive and the line was left alone.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Gangplank's Powder Kegs is down.
edits.after: Parrrley-popped kegs out-range your melee autos — defuse loose barrels with an attack and just farm.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gangplank must walk into your range.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy (W) cleanses your Q slow and heals him, so your poke does nothing — hold your side and defuse kegs.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Powder Kegs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: W sustain and Q shred come online but Parrrley-popped barrels still out-range your melee autos — pay rent through 4-5 and farm to 6.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gangplank's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent gives ranged AoE autos and Divine Judgment (R, 160s at rank 1) survives his burst — the lane is genuinely even from here.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Nashor's Tooth  (the ramp begins), then Riftmaker / Rabadon's Deathcap; boots Sorcerer's Shoes.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Nashor's Tooth, Riftmaker, Rabadon's; boots Sorcerer's. Grievous Wounds blanks Remove Scurvy.

edits.before: His Sheen/Trinity-empowered Parrrley crits and global Cannon Barrage (R) chip you on your own spike timeline and let him splitpush and ult objectives across the map — a fed Gangplank out-values your single-target profile, so close before he free-hits items.
edits.after: His Sheen/Trinity-empowered Parrrley crits and Cannon Barrage (R) — true damage, so armour and MR do not help — chip you on your own spike timeline and let him splitpush and ult objectives across the map; a fed Gangplank out-values you, so close before he free-hits items.

notes: Chart flipped to match the packet and the already-audited Gangplank-side page (rows 1-3 Gangplank, row 4 Skill), both layers, one group. The 'diff': 'FAV' enum and diffRating 7.5/10 sit against a 55.85% win rate and are consistent, so they were left alone. Anti-heal and true-damage interactions from _missing are now on the page.
